items.prompt: the chamber leaked until it was coated with lime mixed with powdered (36) ........
items.evidence: builders plastered it with lime mixed with crushed pottery
items.explanation: The speaker says people used to just call it lime plaster; according to the analyses, the substance that actually keeps the lining flexible is crushed pottery.

items.prompt: the first rain off the roof was held in a small (37) ........ and only overflowed into the tank afterwards
items.evidence: A small settling basin took the dust and the droppings off the roof
items.explanation: In good systems the first rain does not go straight into the cistern; it passes through a small settling basin that catches the dust and droppings off the roof.

items.prompt: every few years each channel had to be cleared, because (38) ........ built up in it
items.evidence: cleared of silt on a cycle of a few years
items.explanation: The first item of maintenance work is clearing the channels every few years of the silt that settles in them.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: every few years the channels had to have the (38) ........ dug out of them
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: cleared of silt on a cycle of a few years
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Cerceve tek adayi ayakta birakiyordu: 'kanallardan (38) kazinmasi gerekiyordu' kalibindaki belirli tanimlik 'the' bilinen bir maddeyi isaret ediyor, 'dig out of a channel' esdizimi de o maddenin adini kendiliginden soyluyordu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Karsitlik ve esdizim cerceveden cikarildi: 'dug out of them' yerine notr bir neden cumlesi ('had to be cleared, because ... built up in it') kondu, belirli tanimlik da atildi. Cerceve artik sand, mud, weed, debris, sediment gibi adaylari ayni derecede mumkun kiliyor; dogru sozcuk ancak konusmacinin bakim listesini duymakla secilebiliyor. yeniden_uretim.sessiz_sinama_1: Uc turun ikisinde dogru bilindi (silt, silt, sediment). Tamamlama ailesinin toplam orani esikte kaldi.
yeniden_uretim.kalan_risk: Cerceve notrlestirildi ama artik sozcuksel bir kalinti var: 'su kanalinda birikip birkac yilda bir temizlenen sey' icin Ingilizcede tek dogal terim silt. Bunu tamamen kapatmak icin konusmacinin sesli bir rakip kurmasi gerekir (or. 'not the weed, the silt') — bu SENARYO isi, bu turda YAPILMADI, ayri bir turda ele alinmali.
yeniden_uretim.sessiz_sinama_son: Son sessiz sinama (2026-08-18, uc bagimsiz tur, senaryo GORULMEDEN, ayni turlarda dokunulmamis kalemlerin taban orani %15): 3/3 (silt, silt, silt) — cerceve duzeltmesi yetmedi.
yeniden_uretim.sonuc: ERTELENDI. Cerceve kusuru (belirli tanimlik + 'dig out of a channel' esdizimi) giderildi ve dosyada birakildi, ama kalem hala sizdiriyor: kalinti cerceveden degil alan bilgisinden geliyor. 'Su kanalinda birikip birkac yilda bir temizlenen sey' icin Ingilizcede tek dogal terim silt oldugundan, hicbir cerceve yazimi bunu kapatmiyor. Kapatmak icin konusmacinin sesli bir rakip kurmasi gerekir (or. once yosun/kum anilip sonra silt'e duzeltilmesi) — bu SENARYO isi ve bu turda YAPILMADI. Kalem bu yuzden isaretli birakildi, mekanizmasi genel_kultur olarak yeniden siniflandirildi.

items.flag_reason: Cerceve notrlestirildikten sonra bile senaryo gosterilmeden 3/3 turda dogru bilindi: bosluk artik esdizimle kilitli degil, ama 'kanalda birikip birkac yilda bir temizlenen madde' kavraminin Ingilizcede tek dogal karsiligi oldugu icin cevap alan bilgisiyle disaridan cikiyor. Cozum sesli rakip kurmayi, yani senaryo degisikligini gerektiriyor.

items.explanation: Although older publications give ten days, the records for the region the speaker studied say twelve days.

items.prompt: the systems failed once a share stopped carrying the (40) ........ with it
items.evidence: when the share stopped carrying the obligation with it
items.explanation: The systems broke down not because a better pump was found, but because a water share stopped carrying with it the obligation to maintain the channel.
